description: Carry out one small task straight from its description, with no plan: the plan-free counterpart of /unikit-implement, and the code-execution skill the pipeline delegates to. It reads the project rules and the engine bridges, works out from the text whether the task is code, editor work (scenes, prefabs, UI, assets, project settings) or both, makes the change, checks that the code compiles, reads the changed editor state back, and ends with a report and an offer to review or commit. Use it when the user says "without a plan", "no plan", "just do it", "directly", "quickly add ...", "set this up in the editor". It reads no plan file and ticks no checkbox. For a bug use /unikit-fix; to carry out an existing plan from .unikit/code/plans/ use /unikit-implement; for a multi-step feature use /unikit-plan; to discuss an approach use /unikit-explore.
